'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=鲙娘}} is a [[NPC]] Chef and owner of [[Yuan's Flavors]]. She was an apprentice and heir to the owner of Yuan's Flavor in [[Mengzhou]], but came to the Hold to open her own branch instead. 

[[Lili]] manages the Restaurant when Fillet Fairmaiden is busy.

==Location==

==Shop==

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
;(Morning)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Caught you, Stoke. Sneaking bites of charcoal again, are we? Hmph!

;(Morning)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Ember, what are you doing hiding in here? It's time to make soup!

;(Afternoon)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Flare, the heat for that stir-fry just now was spot-on. Big bowl of charcoal for you tonight!
:'''Flare:''' *Thrilled noise*

;(Daytime)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Rain for the fields, fresh fare for the belly. So, hungry friend, what's your fancy today?

;(Nightime)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' A bite before bed? Master always said nothing tempts like the midnight dish...

==Dialogue==
;(When working)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' What'll it be? Slow simmer, quick stir-fry, carving n' slicing, I've got it all covered!
:{{Icon/Quest|Dialogue Shop|20}} I want to buy some food
:;(Open Shop)
:;(Purchase)
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' You can't go to Yuan Fortress... But if it's that flavor you're after, you came to the right cook!
::(Not enough Shell Credits)
::'''Rover:''' (I'm running low on Shell Credits. Maybe I'll come back another time.)
:{{DIcon}} About yourself
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' I learned my craft at the restaurant "Yuan's Flavors." Compared to the main house in Mengzhou, this place is really just a Xuanfang branch.
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' But don't you go thinking I skimp on taste, no, no, no. Every dish I serve matches the main house, bite for bite.
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' And truth be told, on the days my master isn't at the stove, I think my dishes turn out better!
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Don't believe me? Ember, Stoke, Flare, flame on! Let's give our guest a little show!
:{{DIcon}} About Ember, Stoke, and Flare
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' You mean those three?
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Ran into 'em after I came to Xuanfang. Put 'em to work once in the kitchen, and they've been shadowing me ever since.
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Now I can't steam, fry, or braise without 'em keeping the heat just right...
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Not that they mind, of course. They know full well that only these hands can make 'em burn their best.
::'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' A good knife needs honing, a good wok needs tending! And a real cook gets attached to her tools.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} 
----
;(When not working)
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Fight in the middle of my cooking again, and you can all forget about charcoal tonight!

:'''Ember & Stoke & Flare:''' *Sulky little noises*
----
;(Past Midnight?)
:{{DIcon|Quest}} Observe the Situation
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Ember, nice work on that stew. Same again tomorrow!
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' Stoke, the water took much too long to boil yesterday. Yes, I'm calling you out!
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' And Flare, less smoke, more sizzle! I couldn't see my own wok in there!
:'''Fillet Fairmaiden:''' That's all for now. Think it over while you chew on your charcoal, alright?
{{Dialogue End}}
